name: Loamstack
tagline: Turn every soil sample into a decision your operation can defend.
positioning: Loamstack converts raw lab panels and field probes into standardized soil intelligence for small growers and independent operators.

hero.h1: Soil intelligence, standardized for the operator.
hero.sub: Loamstack ingests your lab panels, probe logs, and field notes, then returns a single graded soil profile per block — with the nutrient math, thresholds, and audit trail already done.

features.title: Unified lab panel intake
features.description: Upload PDFs from any accredited soil lab. Loamstack normalizes units, maps analytes, and reconciles duplicate samples into one clean block profile.

features.title: Nutrient threshold engine
features.description: Set target ranges per crop and soil texture. We flag every block that drifts out of range and quantify the exact deficit in your working units.

features.title: Block-level trend history
features.description: Track pH, organic matter, and macronutrients across seasons for each field block, so you can prove the direction your ground is actually moving.

features.title: Compliance-ready exports
features.description: Generate nutrient management records formatted for state and buyer audits in one click — timestamped, versioned, and signed.

features.title: Probe and sensor sync
features.description: Connect handheld probes and in-ground moisture sensors. Field readings land in the same profile as your lab work, no re-keying.

features.title: Sampling route planner
features.description: Map your grid points, assign them to seats, and route the day's pulls so no zone gets missed before the lab cutoff.

testimonials.quote: Before Loamstack our soil results lived in a shoebox of PDFs. Now every block has a graded profile and my agronomist stops guessing. The buyer audit last fall took twenty minutes instead of two days.
testimonials.name: Dale Hutchins

testimonials.quote: The threshold engine caught a phosphorus deficit on three blocks I would have missed. We corrected the program before planting and the trend history proves it worked.
testimonials.name: Renata Ochoa

testimonials.quote: We manage sampling across four leased parcels. Per-seat pricing meant I could add my two scouts without a procurement meeting. The route planner alone paid for the year.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feuerstein

pricing.blurb: For single-operation owners standardizing their own soil work.
For growers and agronomists managing multiple blocks and scouts.
For cooperatives and multi-parcel operations with audit obligations.

homepage.footerBlurb: Loamstack is soil analytics infrastructure for the people who actually work the ground. One profile per block. Every number defensible.
